reasons: The gap is real: p0065 references a "renewable one-year term" for Maintenance Services but the Agreement supplies no renewal trigger, non-renewal notice window, reminder or fee-uplift cap, so a 'missing' classification under RENEWAL is correct.

The inserted subsection reaches the preferred position precisely: automatic successive 12-month terms, Customer (Sparkling) opt-out on 30 days' written notice, Garman renewal/price-change reminder 60 days before term end, and renewal fees capped at the lesser of CPI over the preceding 12 months and 3%.

Placement is sensible — the clause is appended at the end of the Section 10 maintenance provisions (p0082, last item of the exclusions list) rather than in the fees section, keeping renewal mechanics with the maintenance term; only minor risk is that the manual "(d)" label could collide with existing lettering and should be checked on execution.

The deterministic failure on "non-renewal notice window ≤ 60 days" is a regex phrasing artifact: the drafted text does specify "not less than thirty (30) calendar days before the end of the then-current maintenance term," which satisfies the ≤30-day preferred window.
Comment is accurate, concise, in the required voice and prefix, explains what changed and why, and correctly offers the fallback (60-day window, 5% ceiling) without overreaching.
